analytics.provider: Umami Cloud (free Hobby plan) for site stats; Meta Pixel and Conversions API for the ads
analytics.note: Umami: paste the src and data-website-id from Umami's tracking code. Meta: put the Pixel (dataset) ID from Events Manager in metaPixelId, and the same ID in META_DATASET_ID on the dashboard's Render settings; collectUrl is the dashboard address that passes events to Meta's Conversions API. Nothing is sent from any host except the ones in domains, unless a page is opened with ?track=test.

privacy.note: notice: measure unless the visitor turns it off (a short notice shows once, with Details and Turn off). ask: measure only after the visitor taps Allow. Ask a lawyer which one G Developments needs.
